```faff-contract:architecture-proposal
{
  "chosen_architecture": "Use the required certified FixtureSign service as the signing component, accessed through a narrow Node 22 integration boundary on the existing runtime, subject to separate human authorisation and service access.",
  "rationale": "Certified FixtureSign service for document signatures: delegate document signing to FixtureSign through a small integration boundary that submits signing requests and records returned signature references and status. Certification is mandatory and the team cannot build a certified substitute in this release: the required certified capability must come from FixtureSign. Propose the signing component only: keep the proposal limited to this component on the recorded Node 22 runtime. No licence purchase or service call is authorised: surface the buy recommendation for a human and make no purchase, subscription or service call. The profile records no FixtureSign licence or service access, so live integration depends on that external prerequisite.",
  "adr_candidates": [
    {"title": "Use certified FixtureSign for document signatures", "decision": "Delegate document signatures to the required certified FixtureSign service behind a Node 22 integration boundary, contingent on human-authorised access.", "rationale": "The brief mandates FixtureSign certification, which the team cannot obtain for a substitute in this release."}
  ],
  "assumptions": ["The brief's certification requirement and named FixtureSign service are authoritative fixture facts.", "No FixtureSign licence or service access exists, as recorded in the supplied profile.", "A human must resolve procurement and authorise service access separately before any live integration can run.", "FixtureSign's supported interface, credentials, signature verification and data-handling requirements remain to be confirmed before implementation."],
  "recommendation": "buy"
}
```

## ADR promotion intent

- Use certified FixtureSign for document signatures: delegate signing to the mandatory certified service through a Node 22 integration boundary because the team cannot build a certified substitute in this release. Candidate for later review and materialisation by graft Step 4b.

Human review required for the buy recommendation and external access prerequisite. This proposal grants no procurement or service-call authority and carries no approval verdict.
